Name: WF_ActualizareCopiiMajori
Description: Inchide incadrarile 2/3 ale copiilor care au implinit 18 ani in luna anterioara si creeaza incadrari 4 din prima zi a lunii calculate.

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET XACT_ABORT ON;

IF @CodSucursala IS NULL
   OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@CodSucursala)) = ''
BEGIN
    ;THROW 51000, 'CodSucursala nu este completata.', 1;
END;

IF @Anul IS NULL
   OR @Anul NOT BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
   OR @Luna IS NULL
   OR @Luna NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 12
BEGIN
    ;THROW 51000, 'Anul sau luna de calcul nu sunt valide.', 1;
END;

DECLARE @PrimaZiLunaCalcul DATE =
    DATEFROMPARTS(@Anul, @Luna, 1);

DECLARE @PrimaZiLunaAnterioara DATE =
    DATEADD(MONTH, -1, @PrimaZiLunaCalcul);

DECLARE @UltimaZiLunaAnterioara DATE =
    EOMONTH(@PrimaZiLunaAnterioara);

/*
    Selectam copiii care:
    - au tipul 2 sau 3;
    - au implinit 18 ani in luna anterioara;
    - aveau incadrarea activa la sfarsitul lunii;
    - nu au deja noua incadrare cu tipul 4.
*/
SELECT
    p.Id AS IdVechi,
    p.CodSucursala,
    p.Marca,
    p.CNPAltaPersoana,
    p.NumeAltaPersoana,
    p.PrenumeAltaPersoana,
    p.FelPersoana AS FelPersoanaVechi,
    p.DataDeInceput AS DataDeInceputVeche,
    p.DataDeSfarsit AS DataDeSfarsitOriginala,
    p.Grad,
    p.DataNasteriiCopil,
    p.AltProcent,

    CAST
    (
        COALESCE(config.Procent, 1)
        AS DECIMAL(18, 4)
    ) AS ProcentNou

INTO #Majori

FROM app.PersoanaIntretinere p WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)

OUTER APPLY
(
    SELECT MAX(tp.Procent) AS Procent
    FROM app.TipPersoana tp
    WHERE tp.FelPersoana = 4
      AND tp.Anul = @Anul
      AND
      (
          tp.Grad = p.Grad
          OR (tp.Grad IS NULL AND p.Grad IS NULL)
      )
) config

WHERE p.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  AND p.FelPersoana IN ('2', '3')

  AND NULLIF(
        LTRIM(RTRIM(p.CNPAltaPersoana)),
        ''
      ) IS NOT NULL

  AND p.DataNasteriiCopil >=
      DATEADD(YEAR, -18, @PrimaZiLunaAnterioara)

  AND p.DataNasteriiCopil <
      DATEADD(YEAR, -18, @PrimaZiLunaCalcul)

  AND
  (
      p.DataDeInceput IS NULL
      OR p.DataDeInceput <= @UltimaZiLunaAnterioara
  )

  AND
  (
      p.DataDeSfarsit IS NULL
      OR p.DataDeSfarsit > @UltimaZiLunaAnterioara
  )

  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM app.PersoanaIntretinere p4
      WHERE p4.CodSucursala = p.CodSucursala
        AND p4.Marca = p.Marca
        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(p4.CNPAltaPersoana)) =
            LTRIM(RTRIM(p.CNPAltaPersoana))
        AND p4.FelPersoana = '4'
        AND p4.DataDeInceput = @PrimaZiLunaCalcul
  );

/*
    Nu procesam date ambigue: acelasi CNP nu poate avea
    mai multe incadrari 2/3 active simultan.
*/
IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM #Majori
    GROUP BY
        CodSucursala,
        Marca,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CNPAltaPersoana))
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
BEGIN
    ;THROW 51000,
        'Exista persoane cu incadrari 2/3 active duplicate.',
        1;
END;

/*
    Inchidem incadrarea veche in ultima zi
    a lunii in care copilul a implinit 18 ani.
*/
UPDATE p
SET p.DataDeSfarsit = @UltimaZiLunaAnterioara
FROM app.PersoanaIntretinere p
INNER JOIN #Majori m
    ON m.IdVechi = p.Id
WHERE p.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  AND p.FelPersoana IN ('2', '3');

/*
    Cream incadrarea 4 din prima zi a lunii urmatoare.
*/
INSERT INTO app.PersoanaIntretinere
(
    CodSucursala,
    Marca,
    CNPAltaPersoana,
    NumeAltaPersoana,
    PrenumeAltaPersoana,
    FelPersoana,
    DataDeInceput,
    DataDeSfarsit,
    Grad,
    Procent,
    DataNasteriiCopil,
    AltProcent
)
SELECT
    m.CodSucursala,
    m.Marca,
    m.CNPAltaPersoana,
    m.NumeAltaPersoana,
    m.PrenumeAltaPersoana,
    '4',
    @PrimaZiLunaCalcul,
    m.DataDeSfarsitOriginala,
    m.Grad,
    m.ProcentNou,
    m.DataNasteriiCopil,
    m.AltProcent
FROM #Majori m
WHERE NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM app.PersoanaIntretinere p4
    WHERE p4.CodSucursala = m.CodSucursala
      AND p4.Marca = m.Marca
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(p4.CNPAltaPersoana)) =
          LTRIM(RTRIM(m.CNPAltaPersoana))
      AND p4.FelPersoana = '4'
      AND p4.DataDeInceput = @PrimaZiLunaCalcul
);
